description: Base Renovate configuration for sbaerlocher repositories

packageRules.description: Pre-1.0 packages: SemVer does not guarantee backward compatibility; treat any non-patch bump as potentially breaking and require manual review.

sbaerlocher/.github - date tags, no digest pinning, weekly rollout. merge.yml cuts a YYYY-MM-DD tag on every push to main, so a daily schedule opens one PR per workflow change in every consumer repo (26 tags in the 30 days to 2026-09-02). Batching the rollout to Monday keeps the rolling-release model while cutting consumer PR churn to roughly 4 per month. `groupSlug` is what carries the schedule, not `groupName`: Renovate derives the branch from `slugify(groupSlug ?? groupName)` and evaluates `schedule` per branch, and packageRules merge last-wins per key - so the `groupSlug: all-non-major` from the non-major rule above survives a bare `groupName` override here (a tag bump like 2026-08-31 -> 2026-09-04 is a minor under this rule's own regex versioning, so that rule does match). Without an explicit groupSlug the bump lands on `renovate/all-non-major` and this window either does nothing or defers every other non-major update with it. `minimumReleaseAge` is deliberately waived: the Monday window is itself the soak, and a 1-day gate would push any tag cut over the weekend past the window and on to the next Monday, an 8-day lag. An urgent workflow fix is still reachable on demand via the Dependency Dashboard checkbox.

Custom regex managers tracking Docker images via env-var markers (e.g. `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=foo` over `IMAGE_VERSION: '1.2.3'`) cannot accept a digest — the regex captures only the version. Disable digest pinning to avoid 'Digest is not updated' branch failures.
